verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows LocalAI connecting to cloud AI providers (such as hosted OpenAI or Anthropic models) alongside local models in its web interface. Its OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs are endpoints LocalAI serves to clients, not connections it makes to cloud providers. Remote gRPC backends, MCP tool servers and distributed worker nodes are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface
